thread:
arjun: Quick sync — ACME flagged that during our private deploy upgrade they need deterministic egress IPs for webhook allowlists. They want a guaranteed, stable set per-tenant rather than a range.

meli: Thanks. Do we know if this is a field constraint or a compliance/legal ask?

samira: It's both. Netops at ACME requires it for security reviews; compliance also signed off on rollout if IPs are stable.

arjun: Right. Customer timeline: they want migration window in Q3 end. Suggested options: 1) long-lived NAT mapping per tenant (sticky egress), 2) VIP per-tenant with BGP/peering, 3) relay/proxy in their VPC. Tradeoffs on cost/complexity.

dan: From runtime side, sticky NAT sounds easiest but has scaling limits. VIP per-tenant is expensive and complicates installer. Relay/proxy offloads burden to customer but needs docs + operator support.

meli: We should spec acceptance criteria for QA: a) deterministic egress for a tenant across restarts, b) documented failure modes, c) upgrade rolling plan that preserves IPs.

samira: Proposal: add a 'egress.mode' installer flag with values [sticky-nat, vip, customer-relay]. Default sticky-nat. Add test harness that simulates node replacement and verifies IP stability.

arjun: Amen. Example config snippet:

```
# operator.yaml
egress:
  mode: sticky-nat
  sticky_timeout: 30m
```

dan: For sticky-nat we need a KV-backed allocation map and a serial allocator to avoid collisions during upgrades. I'll spike this week.

meli: Add back-compat note: existing clusters without this flag should behave as today. New clusters default to sticky-nat.

samira: Field ops ask: include a migration tool to reserve IPs ahead of upgrade windows and export a CSV for customer firewall teams.

arjun: Owner matrix: dan -> spike + PR for allocator; samira -> acceptance tests + migration tool prototype; meli -> prioritize on Q3 roadmap and write acceptance criteria; arjun -> customer comms and runbook.

netops-bot: Reminder: new ticket created -> PRODINF-1213 (link: https://issues.redwood.ai/PRODINF-1213)

meli: Can we estimate eng effort? Dan, ballpark story points for spike + MVP?

dan: Spike 3, MVP 8-13 (depends on allocator complexity). If we need VIP option later that's extra.

samira: We'll schedule a short field demo with ACME next Wed. Need to have prototype for demo.

arjun: OK. Action items: dan spike by Fri, samira prototype by Tue demo branch, meli to slot on roadmap and prepare release note. :thumbsup: 

meli: Thanks — I'll add to the Q3 sprint board and ping CS for customer comms.

samira: Adding checklist to the runbook and tagging @oncall for upgrade window procedures.

arjun: Great. If nobody objects I'll move this to 'high' priority for Q3.

meli: No objections. :rocket: 

dan: fine with prioritization.

(netops-bot reaction: :white_check_mark:)
